title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Strong and Gentle in the Same Hour
caption:
The world gave him two options: hard as stone or soft as paper. Jesus was neither.

He wept at a grave and flipped tables in a temple. A godly man carries both, and knows which room needs which.

Where do you need the other one this week?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #manhood #strength #gentleness
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
